A marketplace will be held at Hanno Komachi Park to coincide with the Hanno Hina Doll Festival. Food trucks will be on site selling a variety of items including shaved ice, crepes, kebabs, and spare ribs.

Dates: Saturday, February 28; Sunday, March 1; Saturday, March 7; Sunday, March 8

Parking: There is no parking at the venue. Please use nearby paid parking lots or coin parking facilities. Vendor offerings may change depending on weather conditions.
